lines.text: Remember Gerald? Nobody stopped him before Christmas.
So now he owns three hundred boxes, and has no idea what's inside.
Gerald did the only thing he could. He wrapped them all.
Then he heard about Christmas dinner. Gerald is a turkey.
So he stacked every present into a giant Christmas tree,
and hid on top, pretending to be the star.
Nobody noticed. Merry Christmas, Gerald. See you at New Year's.
